# GFM specification fixture

`gfm-spec.txt` is the GitHub Flavored Markdown specification from
https://github.com/github/cmark-gfm/blob/0.29.0.gfm.13/test/spec.txt,
version 0.29 (2019-04-06), by the CommonMark and GitHub contributors.
The specification declares CC-BY-SA 4.0:
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/.
It is redistributed unmodified as a test corpus, outside the deployed site.
`GFM-LICENSE` is cmark-gfm's code license; it does not replace the specification's license.
